description.narrative:
The overall objective of Danish funding for development research is to strengthen research capacity and support high quality research in the Global South that produces evidence to address sustainable development challenges and informs decision-making by policymakers and other users of research outputs.
The anticipated outcomes of Danish support to development research are: a) Production of new knowledge that is applied in practice; b) strengthened capacity at individual-, partnership-, and institutional-level, and; c) strengthened research networks and collaborative learning.
Danida Fellowship Centre manages the funds for development research and is responsible for the administration of the competitive calls for research applications as well as for implementing supporting activities, including training in strengthened communication about research findings and other activities aimed at supporting the transformation of research generated knowledge into action.
Find more information here: https://dfcentre.com/research/
